Special benchmark tests MBFA against game engine project files, 3D mesh formats, config and script formats, DixScript (source + compiled binary), PE/COFF assemblies, and dedicated Showcase files designed to exercise MBFA's strongest compression paths (repetitive blocks, sparse binary, tile-based game maps). All formats are compressed by MBFA, gzip, zstd, xz, brotli, and zpaq — then ranked.

The Direct File Test below lets you drop any file and get browser gzip stats instantly. MBFA in-browser compression requires the WASM build — see instructions in that section.

To publish the WASM build:
1. In GitHub open Actions → MBFA WASM → Run workflow, or push a commit whose message contains --wasm or --all
2. The workflow builds web/mbfa-wasm with wasm-pack, roundtrips test data through the real .wasm under Node, and only then copies mbfa.js and mbfa_bg.wasm to the gh-pages root
3. Reload this page — ../mbfa.js is picked up automatically

Contract this page expects: compress(bytes, maxFolds?) and decompress(bytes), both taking and returning Uint8Array.
